scope: Rental Studio admin setup and desktop/mobile usability. Local source changes only.
changes: Daily work, new booking, calendar and physical pieces in a compact primary navigation.
Purpose-labelled More tools cards, grouped shop settings, first-use rental setup guide.
Three-step guided price/fitting, actual physical-piece registration, review/activation.
Responsive booking and inventory cards; single DOM for each record, accessible labels and staff status copy.
Exact tenant-scoped linked-product lookup; missing products stop setup and merchant titles are preserved.
Pending prices/piece entries block activation; quantity/rack/condition changes participate in unsaved-change handling.
Guided setup hands the selected offer to bundle editing; optional fees, fitting, manual codes, labels and maintenance remain accessible.
Immediate workspace mode refresh after settings save; direct settings links render correctly.
One workshop/settlement tool mounted at a time; staff permissions retained.
Readable pieces/offers search, bounded existing API pagination, safe retry on incomplete responses.

visualInspection: mobile daily work and booking cards
desktop daily work and tool menu

limits: Browser QA uses isolated fixtures, not hosted shop data.
No live licence, SMS, storage, payments or physical shop operations were exercised.
Backend rules, production secrets, prices and physical shop inventory were not changed.
